title: Padlássöprés és a vas országa (Attic Sweeping & Command Economy)
grammar: Authoritarian Mechanics, Totalitarian Discourse & State Terror Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say how the state treated the peasants in the early 1950s.
I can say what the attic sweeping and the compulsory delivery were.
I can say what Sztálinváros was and what the iron-and-steel slogan meant.
I can use six words about the command economy, such as padlássöprés and beszolgáltatás.
